subject: Operational orchestration & MAP: migration runway + canary & training
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medivista.com>, Simone Vega <s.vega@medivista.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Operational orchestration & MAP: migration runway + canary & training

Hi Daniel / Simone —

Thanks again for the contract signature last week. Per our kickoff, I attached a first-pass MAP that embeds the post-signature implementation plan (rollout windows, canary gates, migration cutover steps, and the training cadence for your ops and data teams). Highlights in this email:

- Goal: staged rollout to production with a single canary cluster for initial traffic exposure, followed by a full migration over three weeks.
- Canary window: 6 business days (two business days smoke, three business days load, one business day acceptance).
- Training: two half-day sessions for platform admins + two office-hour drop-ins during the canary.
- Key owners:
  - Redwood PM (me): program owner, escalation contact
  - Redwood Ops (Laura): canary runbook owner + pre-cutover checklist
  - Customer Eng (Jonas): migration sequencing, data validation checks
  - Customer Contact (Daniel): acceptance sign-off and scheduling

Attachments: MAP_Medivista_v1.pdf (mutual action plan with embedded timelines), canary-runbook_medivista.xlsx (detailed gates & rollbacks), training-curriculum_medivista.docx (agenda + pre-reqs).

Ask: Please review the MAP and confirm the following by EOD Wednesday (2025-09-17):
1) Preferred start date for the canary week (we propose Mon 2025-09-22)
2) Two names from your ops team for training invites
3) Any regulatory or audit windows we should avoid during migration

If that works, we’ll lock the dates and circulate the detailed calendar invites + runbook.

Thanks —
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MAP_Medivista_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); canary-runbook_medivista.xlsx (XLSX, 180KB); training-curriculum_medivista.docx (DOCX, 320KB)

Subject: Re: Operational orchestration & MAP: migration runway + canary & training

Thanks Michael — this looks good and very actionable. Quick responses inline: 

> - Canary window: 6 business days (two business days smoke, three business days load, one business day acceptance).
We can do that cadence. Prefer starting the canary on Tue 2025-09-23 because QA has a planned maintenance on Mon 2025-09-22 (I should have flagged that earlier).

> Ask: Please review the MAP and confirm the following by EOD Wednesday (2025-09-17):
1) Preferred start date for the canary week (we propose Mon 2025-09-22)
-> We prefer Tue 2025-09-23.

2) Two names from your ops team for training invites
-> Ops leads: Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@medivista.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@medivista.com>. Please add them.

3) Any regulatory or audit windows we should avoid during migration
-> Nothing scheduled beyond the QA work on 9/22, but I’ll confirm by EOD Wed.

Also, for the canary acceptance criteria, can you confirm the expected KPI thresholds we should watch (latency p95, error rate, token-cost delta)? We want to make sure our SREs have concrete gates.

Appreciate it.
Daniel

Daniel Park
Head of Platform, Medivista Health
daniel.park@medivista.com | +1 (617) 555-0147

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Operational orchestration & MAP: migration runway + canary & training

Laura / Jonas / Marissa — forwarding Daniel’s confirmation. Summary and internal asks: 

- Canary start moved to Tue 2025-09-23 (QA maintenance on Mon).
- Customer ops leads: Carmen Lee, Arjun Patel. Add to training invites and canary war room.
- Action items for us: 
  1) Laura: update canary-runbook_medivista.xlsx with explicit KPI thresholds. Customer asked specifically for p95 latency, error rate, and per-token delta. Suggest thresholds: p95 latency <= 450ms, error rate < 0.5%, per-token cost delta < 15% vs baseline. Can you validate?
  2) Jonas: finalize data validation scripts and sequence for blue->green traffic ramp (0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%). Document the automated checks that will block progression.
  3) Marissa: prep training slides and two half-day session agendas (admin + developer). Include an ops runbook walkthrough and run the first admin session the week before canary (propose Fri 2025-09-19, 10:00-13:00).

Please reply with confirmations and any conflicts. I’ll update the MAP and re-issue to Daniel/Simone once we have KPI thresholds.

Thanks —
Michael

> > Thanks Michael — this looks good and very actionable...

--
Michael Grant

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@medivista.com>, Simone Vega <s.vega@medivista.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational orchestration & MAP: migration runway + canary & training

All — quick updates and confirmations below.

1) KPI thresholds: agreed and set in the runbook (attached):
   - p95 latency: <= 450ms
   - error rate (5xx + client errors exceeding SLA): < 0.5%
   - token-cost delta: < 15% vs baseline (baseline measured during initial pilot traffic)

2) Canary cadence: confirmed start Tue 2025-09-23. We’ll use the following ramp schedule: Day 0 (smoke): 0->5% -> Day 2: 10% steady -> Day 4: 30% -> Day 6: acceptance & sign-off. Exact ramp triggers are in canary-runbook_medivista.xlsx (attached).

3) Training: Marissa will run two half-day sessions: Fri 2025-09-19 10:00-13:00 (admin ops) and Mon 2025-09-22 09:00-12:00 (developer integrations). Carmen and Arjun added to invites.

4) Escalation path: if any gate is tripped, we execute the rollback play (immediate traffic switch to baseline cluster + incident call with Redwood on-call, customer SRE, and program PM). We captured primary contacts in the MAP.

Next steps: Michael to upload updated MAP + runbook with KPI cells populated and send calendar invites for training + canary war room. Daniel — please confirm acceptance after reviewing the attached runbook.

Thanks —
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Redwood Operations
